title: Saas Mirchi Bahu Achaar
desc: A family navigates through troubles and deceptions, despite constant bickering. However, constant love and sacrifice help to mend the broken relationships.

title: Kyun Ki Har Ek Saas Zaroori Hoti Hai
desc: Mausam is educated, but this irks her mother-in-law Dhaneshwari. Distraught, Mausam vents to her deceased grandmother-in-law's photo, who then possesses her to teach Dhaneshwari a lesson.

title: Farishta
desc: A father rejects his son with a mental disability and sends him to prison. However, years later the father and son reunite during a troubling time in their lives.

title: Dilwala
desc: A joint family gets separated when the eldest son marries his employer's daughter and the second son decides to go abroad. The youngest son takes care of his parents and brings the family together.

title: Rishton Ka Batwara
desc: Members in a family argue over property claims and take each other to court. However, this dispute drives a wedge in their relationships which affects future generations.

title: Baaghi - Ek Yodha
desc: A soldier falls in love with a woman and decides to make her his life partner. However, his family is against his wishes and abandons him.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
